Question 13(b) [3 marks]: JCC are considering outsourcing the production of cricket balls. Describe how outsourcing could help this business sustain its competitive advantage.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Jiminy's Cricket Company (JCC) manufactures high quality cricket gear. In order to improve profitability materials will now be sourced from the global market.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 3):
3 marks: Provides a comprehensive description of how outsourcing could help this business sustain its competitive advantage
2 marks: Provides a description of how outsourcing could help this business sustain its competitive advantage
1 marks: Makes a statement about outsourcing

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Outsourcing is the process of using external providers, or third-party specialist businesses, to perform business activities. For JCC, outsourcing would involve contracting a manufacturer to make cricket balls for them, allowing JCC to focus on producing high quality bats, pads and helmets while an expert cricket ball business handles the balls. The outsourced business would have specialised equipment JCC may not have, which decreases costs. Ensuring all products are of the highest quality increases their reputation as a brand, helping them grow and increase market share. The cost savings would increase profit, helping JCC sustain its competitive advantage.


TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Most students were able to define outsourcing. They needed to provide more links to how outsourcing could achieve specific competitive advantage indicators, for example greater profitability or market share over competitors.
